title_en: Dream of the Red Chamber (11/20): Daiyu Falls Gravely Ill
note_en: 比 can compare something with itself over time: 天气一天比一天冷 "the weather grew colder day by day" (literally "one day colder than the day before"). Its cousin 越来越 does the same job without naming the time unit: 咳嗽得越来越厉害 "her cough got worse and worse," 越来越苍白 "paler and paler." Notice that the adjective stays in its plain form; Chinese has no "-er" ending.
